description: Cross-language contract data. Every file in this directory must be listed here, with the suites that must consume it. Checked by scripts/check_manifest.py (just contract).

a2a-parts.json.description: Valid and malformed A2A v1.0 parts, SPEC sections 7.2 and 10.2. The daemon (agentconnect.limits) and the SDK (agentconnect_sdk.models) must classify every entry the same way. Hand-written.

instance-cert.json.description: Identity id, fingerprint, mailbox id and InstanceCert JCS/signature vectors, SPEC sections 2 and 3.3. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from fixed inputs and a seeded RNG.

invite-kdf.json.description: join_key/welcome_key derivation, JoinRequest MAC and WrappedWelcome vectors, SPEC sections 3.5, 6.1 and 6.4. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from fixed inputs and a seeded RNG.

invite-urls.json.description: Valid and invalid invite URLs, SPEC section 4.1. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from fixed inputs and a seeded RNG.

padding-vectors.json.description: Application padding buckets, SPEC section 7.1. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from fixed inputs and a seeded RNG.

relay-auth.json.description: Relay WebSocket challenge and signed REST request signatures by the instance key, SPEC sections 8.1.1 and 8.2. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from a seeded RNG; also verified by the relay (relay/tests/auth_vector.rs).

sas-emoji.json.description: Matrix SAS emoji table (64 entries) used for SAS rendering, SPEC section 11. Kept byte-for-byte as published upstream.

sas-vectors.json.description: SAS derivation from fixed epoch_authenticator bytes and its emoji/decimal renderings, SPEC sections 3.5 and 11. Generated by core/src/vectors.rs (just vectors) from fixed inputs and a seeded RNG.
